objective: Improve the family's state-conditioned joint posterior learner itself, not its prediction head or inputs.
motivation: Covariance-sketch v3 retained useful geometry but lost to full covariance on stationary and heteroscedastic-switch streams. Do not promote its compute advantage as stronger learning. Test the single-linearization approximation in the full learner next.
hypothesis: A noisy nonlinear observation may require more than one tangent approximation. Fixed-prior iterated EKF can refine the mean's local observation fit without falsely treating that observation as multiple independent pieces of evidence.

method.prior: theta0 and C=P+diag(Q) are fixed throughout the current observation's inner iterations; R comes from prior history.
method.iteration: j_k=grad f(theta_k,x); v_k=C j_k; s_k=R+j_k^T v_k; e_k=f(theta_k,x)-y-j_k^T(theta_k-theta0); theta_(k+1)=theta0-v_k e_k/s_k.
method.posterior: After the final inner iteration only: P_new=C-v_k v_k^T/s_k. Add Q once, assimilate evidence once, update inferred R once from the original pre-update residual.
method.reference: One iteration is the frozen full-network EKF; a linear-in-parameters observation gives the same result for any iteration count.
method.novelty_limit: Iterated EKF is an established method, not a claimed invention. Its value in this neural plasticity setup is an empirical hypothesis.
method.risk: Local Gauss-Newton iteration can oscillate, fit observation noise, or chase a poor local mode. More iterations need not improve prequential or clean held-out error. No clipping, fallback, or repeated posterior conditioning to hide this.

data.confirmation: Run full stationary stream if primary improves sustained clean risk over the full-covariance reference; otherwise reject this hypothesis without a favorable endpoint substitution.

selection.criterion: Independent duration-weighted sustained clean-validation error; every successful arm locks before any untouched test scoring. Report every grid and edge winner. Never select from clean test or use clean targets in the optimizer.

success: Primary iterated4 lowers sustained clean test MSE versus network at independently validation-selected interior priors. Report endpoint and both phases; reject a favorable endpoint if sustained risk worsens. Any nonfinite configuration remains a failure rather than a secretly removed candidate.

execution.precision: CUDA float32 highest precision, TF32 disabled; compiled single-observation CUDA graph. No CPU/eager fallback.
execution.autocull: No performance cull within fixed65536-observation stream; complete midpoint-switch recovery is required. Fail visibly on invalid numerical state. Clear disjoint-arm Dynamo caches without raising cache limits.

verification: Independent double-precision/autograd nonlinear recurrence; exact linear Gaussian invariance; one-iteration reference parity; Q/noise/observation only assimilated once; clean-target isolation; complete capture restoration and sample clocks. Root TensorBoard events and durable selection/checkpoint/source/data evidence.
limits: One paired task seed, no PPO or global-optimality claim. Joint coordinated geometry is not autonomous scalar per-neuron gating. More inner iterations cost more compute and are not compute-matched.
